established_evidence.matched_result: The family-balanced treatment was validly measured but did not improve weak atomic aggregate relative to V7; it therefore does not support scalar loss balancing alone as a sufficient intervention.
established_evidence.schedule_audit: Equal episode counts yielded highly unequal nominal loss coefficients (inside/contains 24.74%, difference 24.46%, orientation 2.52%, width 1.81%, connected components 1.78%); this is a property of the worker/schedule, not a gradient measurement.

hypotheses.H1_SUPERVISED_FITTING_OR_COVERAGE: Weak atomic families may remain poorly fit under the frozen sequence and duration.
hypotheses.H2_GRADIENT_INTERFERENCE: Family gradients may conflict, but no gradient-direction evidence exists.
hypotheses.H3_GENERALIZATION: Training-set fit may improve without transfer to Target DEV.

not_authorized: Any GPU inference or model loading

proposed_next_stage_if_director_authoriz.controls: Same tokenizer, label masking, runtime, and per-family aggregation for every checkpoint; no DEV/retention labels used in calculation; FINAL_AUDIT sealed.
proposed_next_stage_if_director_authoriz.decision_rule: If a weak family shows lower teacher-forced train NLL yet no DEV gain, H3 gains support; if no train-NLL improvement, H1 gains support. H2 remains UNKNOWN unless a separate, decision-changing gradient diagnostic is approved.
proposed_next_stage_if_director_authoriz.expected_information: Distinguishes fitting-versus-generalization evidence without changing a training hyperparameter or launching another repair round.
proposed_next_stage_if_director_authoriz.intervention: No optimizer steps, no checkpoint mutation, no generation, no training, no data resampling. Run teacher-forced per-family NLL on the frozen 400 TRAIN rows for V7 and the already frozen rejected candidates; join only to already frozen DEV/retention results.

purpose: Obtain a prospective basis for a distinct atomic-repair protocol after the V7-start fixed-schedule and family-balanced-loss routes were both closed.
research_objective: Preserve strong capabilities, repair weak atomic prerequisites, then evaluate composition transfer.
